coverage_notes.exclusions: Recent indexed reports on Roseland maternity suspension, Prime Healthcare OB suspensions, Tehama air ambulance closure, and other earlier service losses are not newly established and/or already known. October 23 Piggott Community Hospital cancer center opening is a new service, not a restoration/reopening of previously lost essential care, so outside this recall watch scope. Kula Hospital restoration plans have no effective reopening date and emergency department remains closed. Generic risk articles, proposals, business-only changes, and stale reports excluded.
coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted fresh-news searches returned predominantly older articles rather than newly dated qualifying events. Search coverage is bounded and does not establish absence of unindexed events. No material source retrieval failure observed.
coverage_notes.controls: No editorial approval, publication, production collector, schedule, or task changes.
